parity: both turns token-for-token identical to the eager 128-slot reference in both modes

timing_per_token.note: route now includes the GPU execution moved out of gemv by the inner graph

graph_persistence: torch.musa.MUSAGraph exposes capture_begin/capture_end/replay/instantiate/debug_dump/raw_musa_graph(_exec) but no save/load/serialization API; graph executables embed process-local device pointers
ceiling: GPU work is already about 33 ms/token (baseline full graph is about 32 ms); exposed fill+host is about 30 ms/token. Perfect host/I/O overlap would cap at roughly 25-30 tok/s, but route dependency prevents overlapping the next layer's work; reducing misses or fill cost is the remaining lever.
